label: prop:feynman-classical-limit
title: Classical limit: recovery of the symmetric path integral
html:
Proposition (conditional on conj:classical-limit-stpart — classical limit). In the q \to 1 limit of the categorical trace, the following degenerations occur:

  H_n(R, q) \xrightarrow{\,q \to 1\,} k[S_n], \qquad
  \mathrm{tr}_M \xrightarrow{\,z \to 0\,} \varepsilon.

  1. (Hecke \to symmetric group.) The Hecke relation (T - q)(T + q^{-1}) = 0 becomes T^2 = 1. The Iwahori--Hecke algebra H_n(R, q) degenerates to the group algebra k[S_n].

  2. (Markov trace \to flat character trace.) The Jones--Markov trace parameter z \to 0. The Markov trace \mathrm{tr}_M on H_n(R, q) degenerates to the augmentation map \varepsilon \colon k[S_n] \to k sending every group element to 1.

  3. (Categorical action \to classical action.) The categorical action \mathfrak{S}_q(K) = \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta)) \to \mathfrak{S}_1(\beta), the character of the permutation \pi(\beta) \in S_n. The q-energy reduces to the classical action because the rotational and translational terms vanish with \hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} \to 0.

  4. (Eigenbasis collapse.) The Jones polynomial evaluates to J_K(1) = 1 for every knot K. The Markov trace ceases to distinguish knot types. The eigenspace decomposition V^{\otimes n} \cong \bigoplus_\lambda V_\lambda \otimes S_\lambda persists, but the S_\lambda become Specht modules of S_n, forming the standard angular momentum eigenbasis. The quantum dimensions [2j+1]_q become ordinary dimensions 2j+1.

  5. (Braiding \to symmetric.) The braiding c_{V,V} satisfies c_{V,V}^2 = \mathrm{id}, making the monoidal category symmetric. The non-trivial knot structure collapses, reducing all braid closures to the unknot.

The finite categorical trace degenerates to the standard discrete trace over the finite-dimensional angular momentum eigenbasis of the symmetric group.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall. It applies q-deformation identities over an abstract coefficient ring and specializes them to real-valued observables at q_0.
